lead: One more element on `ClassLayout::methods`' row trips `clippy::type_complexity`.
body: That lint scores a written type at `10 × nesting` per node, so the five-element tuple sits at 220 against a threshold of 250 and a sixth `Vec<String>` puts it at 290 — `-D warnings` in a struct field, a `fn` signature or a `let`, but never in a `type` alias's right-hand side. Widen one of these rosters by naming the tuple, as `nvs_types::layout::MethodEntry` does, and re-export the name so a crate that does not depend on `nvs-types` can still write it.
